name: Vallclara (Spain)
description: Vertically divided yellow and red, charged at the centre with a white Agnus Dei contourné regardant, haloed and bearing a red banner with a white cross.
history: The official flag of Vallclara is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, a vertical bicolour of yellow and red, with the white Agnus Dei contourné regardant of the arms, haloed gold and bearing a red banner with a full white cross; approved by the municipal council on 15 May 2020 and published in the DOGC on 30 September 2020.
